blockNote: East (positive $20) horizontal-phase collision dispatch, east wall-slide handlers and the Y auto-align (186076-186435 + 187085-187264, Bank 02). DispatchEastMove is called once per tick by PlayerMovementTick after $AA bit $0040 is set. It is the mirror image of DispatchDiagDownLeft (player_move_diag, the WEST half) and probes the right-hand corners (TR / BR) where the west file probes TL / BL. The slope handlers it jumps to live in player_move_ramps.
=== CONVENTIONS ===

As in player_move_ns: sub-pixels (4 per pixel), $20 / $22 = X velocity / position, $24 / $26 = Y velocity / position (Y grows downward), $1A / $1E = probe pixel, $00 = map index of the last probe (X still holds it right after a probe), CheckSubTileAlignX / Y carry clear = flush on a 16-px line, carry set = straddling two cells. $06 / $09 are undecoded wall-like types (OQ-I029-5), so 'north wall' / 'south wall' are handler names. In this phase the vertical velocity is parked on PlayerMovementTick's stack and $24 is 0, so the SnapYNorthCollision / SnapYSouthCollision calls here work on the CURRENT Y, not a stepped one.
=== DISPATCH ORDER (DispatchEastMove) ===

1. map_coords.ProbeLeftTiles: slope search at the hitbox centre column (the TR probe X minus 8, i.e. X itself; not a sample 8 px to the left). Z set = slope found: carry set = $05 -> WestRampUp, carry clear = $0A -> EastRampDown. The old header sent $05 to WestRampDown.
2. ProbeCurrentTR $09 -> EastWallNorthHandler; ProbeCurrentBR $06 -> EastWallSouthHandler.
3. ProbeFutureTR: $0E and above -> blocked path; $09 -> EastWallNorthFlag.

4. CheckSubTileAlignY. Y flush: future TR $06 -> EastWallSouthFlag, anything else on to step 5. Y straddling: future TR $06 -> blocked path; otherwise the cell below the future TR cell (MapCellDown) is read: $0E and above -> blocked, $06 -> EastWallSouthFlag, $09 -> blocked, anything else on to step 5 with A = that lower cell's type. The old header put the MapCellDown read in the aligned case; it is the straddling case.

5. A = $07 -> EastLadderTile (A is the future TR type when Y is flush and the lower cell's type when Y straddles). Then ProbeCurrentBL: $05 -> WestRampDown, $0A -> EastRampUp (the old header had WestRampUp for $05).
6. Otherwise $22 += $20.

Blocked path (loc_02D753): SetActorCollisionFlag, AutoAlignNS_East (Y nudge, carry clear = nudged), then SnapXEastCollision. After a nudge the X snap runs without zeroing playerSpeedEw, so the player keeps pushing east and is walked around the corner.

SnapXEastCollision: X' = (((X + $20) - 32) AND $FFC0) + 32 (the second $20 is the immediate constant): the column of the stepped left edge, centred, so the right edge (X + 7 px) ends on the last pixel of that column, flush to the wall. With $20 = 0 (the callers in player_move_ns and player_move_south) it only moves X west. It zeroes $20; the full entry also zeroes playerSpeedEw.
=== WALL-SLIDE HANDLERS ===

EastWallNorthHandler (current TR $09, or future TR $09 through EastWallNorthFlag) and EastWallSouthHandler (current BR $06, or future BR $06 through EastWallSouthFlag) mirror code_02DC4B and code_02DC9F of the west file. They set $AB bit 7 (the Flag entries set bit 2 / bit 3 instead); nothing reads those bits (OQ-I029-3). The probe at the future corner plus CheckSubTileAlignX picks the path. X STRADDLING and the corner type matches ($09 / $06): gap chain. X flush, or another type: SnapYNorthCollision / SnapYSouthCollision first (with $24 = 0: the north snap moves the player DOWN to the next row line, 1..16 px; the south snap floors Y, up to 15 px north), then the corner is re-probed: clear or the same type -> the slide, anything else -> SnapXEastCollision + ApplyMovementDeltas. The old headers had aligned / not aligned the wrong way round.

Gap chains. North (loc_02D7AB): MapCellDown from the future TR cell must be empty or $0A, then MapCellLeft from that cell must be empty or $09. South (loc_02D7FF): MapCellUp from the future BR cell must be empty or $05, then MapCellLeft must be empty or $06. A failed test goes to ClearSpeedEW_5 / _6 (playerSpeedEw = 0, no position applied this tick). Both pass: ComputeEastSnapOffset, then DiagPushRight (north handler) or DiagPushLeft (south handler).

Push direction: DiagPushRight stores a positive $24 and DiagPushLeft a negative one (player_move_diag, OQ-I029-4) and ApplyMovementDeltas adds $24 to Y, so the $09 handler pushes the player SOUTH and the $06 handler pushes NORTH. The old header and comments said the opposite for both. Read together with the west file: TL $06 and TR $09 both push south, BL $09 and BR $06 both push north.
=== AutoAlignNS_East / ComputeEastSnapOffset ===

AutoAlignNS_East returns carry set (no nudge) when the vertical velocity word parked at $06,S is nonzero (not an 'EW velocity' as the old note said), when the collision byte at the last probe index carries an actor solid mark (high nibble), or when n = (($26 >> 2) AND $0F) is 0. For n >= 4 it nudges Y south ($26 += 8 sub-pixels, clamped at the next row line) if FutureBR is below $0E; failing that, for n <= 10, it nudges north ($26 -= 8, clamped at the row line) if FutureTR is below $0E. So n = 1..3 can only go north, 4..10 prefers south, 11..15 can only go south.

ComputeEastSnapOffset: $02 = ($1A AND $0F), plus $10 on the wall path when this step moves the probe across a 16-px column line (bit 4 of $1A XOR ($1A - $20 / 4)). The wall path is taken when the current TR is $09, or when Y straddles and the cell below the current TR is $06; otherwise $02 = $1A AND $0F alone. DiagPushRight / DiagPushLeft add a Y-derived offset to $02 and, above $10, push Y by (total AND $0F) pixels.
Everything here is UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME (no emulator trace); the arithmetic is read from the code.

DispatchEastMove: Entry for positive $20, 8-bit probe mode. Order, exits and the blocked path are described in the block note: JMPs into player_move_ramps or the wall handlers, the plain step $22 += $20, or the blocked path loc_02D753.
SnapXEastCollision: X snap after a blocked east step: X' = (((X + $20) - 32) AND $FFC0) + 32, $20 = 0. The right edge ends flush to the wall; with $20 = 0 (callers in player_move_ns / player_move_south) it only moves X west. The full entry zeroes playerSpeedEw first; the loc_02D766 entry (after a successful Y nudge) keeps it.
EastLadderTile: Type $07 ahead while moving east (a local label inside DispatchEastMove). CheckSubTileAlignY: Y straddling (carry set) -> blocked path. Y flush: DiagClearReturnFlags cancels the vertical phase, the player actor's entry becomes ShimmyRightEntry (low word only) with $0008 = 0, then the blocked path runs (collision flag, Y nudge, X snap). Mirror of DiagLadderTile (ShimmyLeftEntry) in player_move_diag. The old 'West prefix' remark refers to a former name; ShimmyRightEntry is the east case.
EastWallNorthDiag: A single SEP #$20 that falls into EastWallNorthHandler. player_move_ramps jumps here when its post-ramp FutureTR probe reads $09.
EastWallNorthHandler: Wall-slide handler for TR $09 while moving east. Sets $AB bit 7, ProbeFutureTR, CheckSubTileAlignX. X straddling and $09: gap chain (loc_02D7AB). Otherwise SnapYNorthCollision (player goes DOWN to the next row line), re-probe: clear or $09 -> slide, else SnapXEastCollision + ApplyMovementDeltas. Slide: ComputeEastSnapOffset + DiagPushRight, which pushes Y DOWN (positive $24); the old text said up (OQ-I029-4). See the block note.
EastWallNorthFlag: Compact entry used when the future TR is already known to be $09: sets $AB bit 2 (no reader) and joins the gap chain at loc_02D7AB, skipping the probe and the X alignment test. ClearSpeedEW_5 is the shared abort: playerSpeedEw = 0 and return.
ClearSpeedEW_5: Abort of the north-wall gap chain: playerSpeedEw = 0 and RTS. ApplyMovementDeltas is not run, so no position is applied this tick.
EastWallSouthDiag: A single SEP #$20 that falls into EastWallSouthHandler. player_move_ramps jumps here when its post-ramp FutureBR probe reads $06.
EastWallSouthHandler: Wall-slide handler for BR $06 while moving east. Sets $AB bit 7, ProbeFutureBR, CheckSubTileAlignX. X straddling and $06: gap chain (loc_02D7FF): MapCellUp (empty or $05), then MapCellLeft (empty or $06). Otherwise SnapYSouthCollision (Y floored, up to 15 px north), re-probe: clear or $06 -> slide, else SnapXEastCollision + ApplyMovementDeltas. Slide: ComputeEastSnapOffset + DiagPushLeft, which pushes Y UP (negative $24); the old text said down.
EastWallSouthFlag: Entry for a future TR / BR $06 (from DispatchEastMove): STX $00 (X still holds the map index of the last probe or MapCell step), sets $AB bit 3 (no reader) and joins the gap chain at loc_02D7FF. ClearSpeedEW_6 is the shared abort.
ClearSpeedEW_6: Abort of the south-wall gap chain: playerSpeedEw = 0 and RTS; no position is applied this tick.
AutoAlignNS_East: Y auto-align before the east X snap. Carry set = no nudge: vertical velocity parked at $06,S nonzero, actor solid mark at the last probe cell, or n = (($26 >> 2) AND $0F) = 0. n >= 4: south nudge (NudgeToLowerGrid, $26 += 8) if FutureBR < $0E; else n <= 10: north nudge (NudgeToUpperGrid, $26 -= 8) if FutureTR < $0E. Carry clear = nudged. Structural mirror of AutoAlignEW (player_move_main) on the Y axis.
ComputeEastSnapOffset: Builds the push offset $02 for the east wall slide: ($1A AND $0F), plus $10 on the wall path when the step carries the probe across a 16-px column line. Wall path: current TR $09, or Y straddling with $06 in the cell below the current TR. The saved probe pixels $1A / $1E are restored before the final sum.

blockNote: Parent thinker for the scenes that run palette bundle #03 and, while event flag #01 is set, a child thinker that keeps stepping the bundle. thinker-def <#00, #08>: filter word $0800, so it runs in RunThinkers_TypeA and TypeC (every main-loop frame and the lighter frame routines); the child, spawned with SpawnThinker, inherits that word from the parent's animScratch2.

Flow: PaletteStart #03 loads bundle #03 and applies sub-entry 0, then SetEntryHere and a per-frame BranchOnFlagByte #01 poll (Val #01 = branch when the flag is set). While the flag is clear the parent only polls. When it is set, PaletteParentChildSpawnWave spawns PaletteParentChildWaveLoop (SpawnThinker returns the new slot in Y; TYA / STA store it in chatPtr = $7F000A,X), then WaitOnFlagByte #01, #00 halts until the flag clears. The parent then kills the child: PHX, PHD, X = D = the child slot from chatPtr, COP KillThinker, PLD, PLX (the handler unlinks and frees the slot named by X / D, so switching X and D is how a thinker kills another one; the only other site is the unused SceneTransPaletteThinker_unused). It jumps back to loc_00B600, which restarts bundle #03 at sub-entry 0 and polls again.

The child restarts PaletteStart #03 and runs PaletteStep in a BRA loop: PaletteStep yields until the next sub-entry is due and falls through when the bundle ends, so the palette cycles for as long as the flag is set. While the child runs the parent does not touch the palette. The child keeps its own bundle ID in its own $7F0002, so parent and child are independent users of bundle #03.

Spawn records in scene_thinkers.asm: scene $FD (thinker_spawn_0CEB30) and scene $FF (thinker_spawn_0CEB46), each with spawn parameter byte #03 (the same bundle number; the script hard-codes #03 and overwrites the parameter), next to parallax_thinker and ambient_palette_cycler ($FF also spawns inventory_dma_setup). docs/code/bank0C-scene-spawn-tables-comet.md lists the thinker for 'World Map, Inventory'; only $FD and $FF appear in the records (OQ-I040-3). Which scripts set and clear flag #01 in those scenes was not traced (OQ-I040-3).

PaletteParentChildSpawnWave: Spawns the child (PaletteParentChildWaveLoop) and stores its slot in chatPtr, waits for event flag #01 to clear, kills the child by running KillThinker with X = D = the child slot, then restarts the parent at loc_00B600 (bundle #03 sub-entry 0 and the flag poll).
PaletteParentChildWaveLoop: Child thinker: PaletteStart #03 (load sub-entry 0, yield), PaletteStep (yield until the next sub-entry; falls through at the end of the bundle), BRA back. Runs until the parent kills it when flag #01 clears.

blockNote: Invisible large-ramp speed booster (large_ramp_booster, actor-def <#00, #00, #20>). Placed in Incan Ruins room ir21 (1 booster at tile $10,$0B, in scene_event_0C8F57) and in the Diamond Mine minecart room dm41 (2 boosters at $16,$1C and $1B,$0B, in scene_event_0C9A95).
Control flow. BranchIfPlayerNear radius r is true when the player's |dX| and |dY| are both below r * 16 + 1 pixels, so #02 is a 32-px box and #03 a 48-px box.

1. loc_00C966 (also the spawn entry): both playerSpeedEw and playerSpeedNs zero -> RTL and test again next frame. Once either is nonzero: SetEntryHere, then BranchIfPlayerNear #02 -> LargeRampBoostEastWest, else RTL (the entry is now the near-test: the speed gate is not checked again until loc_00C966 is reached later).

2. LargeRampBoostEastWest: playerSpeedEw is incremented when it is zero or positive and decremented when negative (a zero EW speed becomes +1, east, even if only the NS speed was nonzero). Then SetEntryHere and BranchIfPlayerNear #03: within 48 px -> LargeRampBoostNorthSouth, which is just an RTL; outside -> BRA loc_00C966.

3. So the boost happens ONCE per approach: afterwards the entry is the radius-3 test and the actor idles (RTL each frame) until the player is more than 48 px away; only then do the speed gate and the radius-2 test run again. The older header ('increments playerSpeedEw or playerSpeedNs ... each frame') and docs/code/bank00/actors-infrastructure.md ('repeats while player remains near', NS also adjusted) do not match this control flow: playerSpeedNs is only read for the gate and never changed, and LargeRampBoostNorthSouth contains no boost (OQ-I040-1, R-I040-1).
UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME: whether another path adds speed on these ramps, and whether a +/-1 step per approach is the intended feel, was not checked.

large_ramp_booster: Speed gate at the spawn entry (loc_00C966): wait until the player is moving, then poll the 32-px box around this actor. The first box entry calls LargeRampBoostEastWest. See the block note.
LargeRampBoostEastWest: playerSpeedEw += 1 (zero or positive) or -= 1 (negative), once per approach; then the actor polls the 48-px box (LargeRampBoostNorthSouth is an idle RTL) and returns to the speed gate when the player is farther away.
LargeRampBoostNorthSouth: One RTL: the idle yield used while the player stays within 48 px after a boost. There is no north-south boost here; the name is misleading (R-I040-1).
